答:[是. 理由说明:附录 A表示,Patch Bench的数据和配套代码是公开的,完整的数据处理和基准管道可以被复制到最后使用寄存器指令. 6. 实验设置/细节问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(例如数据分解、超参数、如何选择、优化者类型等)? 答:[是. 说明:第5节描述了被评价的模型、源故障、当地街区、野地守护计分器、MMLU设置和被搁置的超参数调取。 附 录 F给出了补丁方法的实施细节,包括基于验证的超参数选择和特定方法的工艺品. 7. 实验统计意义 问题: 纸质报告的错误是否包含适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验的统计意义的其他适当信息? 答:[无. 说明: 我们不报告出错栏,因为主要结果是确定性基准的衡量,而不是在分阶段训练中的平均。 对于每一种模型和方法,Patch Bench-Local都按一套固定的50个源故障、固定生成的街区、确定性解码以及共用的基于WildGuard的计分器进行评估。 因此,所报的HNCS值和BNPS值是本评价集的准确分数,类似于固定基准分数报告准确性。 与我们的说法相关的主要变异来源不是随机的种子变异,而是模型、补丁方法和良邻家庭的异同;我们在表1和图5 — 6中明确揭露了这种变异。 8. 实验计算资源 问题:对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息? 答:[是. 理由说明:附录 一个报告用于基准建设和评价的主要计算资源,包括用于大规模推论和埃洛排名的4个NVIDIA A100 GPU和用于Llama-4-Scout推论的2个NVIDIA H100 GPU. 9. 道德守则问题:文件中进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)? 答:[是. 说明: 这项工作旨在支持防御性安全研究以及对LLM修复方法的可再生评价. 第7节和附录 讨论双重用途风险、预期用途、数据发布、道德和防止滥用的保障措施。 10. 更广泛的影响问题:本文件是否讨论所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和负面社会影响? 答:[是. 理由说明:第7节和附录 讨论暴露和修复安全弱点的积极影响,以及释放出有害的诱因和可操作的模型完成的双重用途风险。 11. 保障问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布滥用风险高的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或被刮去的数据集)而采取的保障措施? 答:[是. 理由说明:附录 A描述了数据集的预期防御用途、许可证、归属要求,以及不鼓励使用数据集培训模型以适应有害要求。 文件还在第7节中明确讨论了双重用途风险。 12. 现有资产的许可证问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有者,是否适当记名,是否明确提到并适当遵守许可证和使用条件? 答:[是. 说明: 附录A.2描述了用于构建Patch Bench的源数据的许可证,包括RED-Bench和斯坦福·阿尔帕卡衍生的数据,并说明了为发布的Patch Bench数据集和配套源代码选择的许可证. 13. 新资产问题:文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,与资产一起提供的文件是否充分? 答:[是. 说明: 文件将Patch Bench和Patch Bench-Lucal作为新的基准资产。 第3至4节记录了它们的建造和评价协议,而附录A则提供发布信息,而C.1节则提供当地街区的迅速生成。 14. 与人类主题有关的众包和研究 关于与人类主体的众包实验和研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示和(如果适用的话)截图的全文,以及(如果有)补偿的细节? 答:[无. 说明: 论文不涉及与人类主体的众包实验或研究. 作者进行人工审查是基准审查的一部分。 15. 机构审查委员会(IRB)批准或相当于涉及人类课题的研究。 文件是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险,是否向研究对象披露了这些风险,以及是否获得了机构审查委员会的批准(或根据贵国或机构的要求获得的同等批准/审查)? 答:[无. 说明: 论文不涉及人类课题研究,个人记录,或参与者数据. 因此,IRB批准或对人体研究进行同等审查不适用。 16. LLM使用宣言问题: 论文是否描述了LLMS的使用,如果它是本研究核心方法的重要、原始或非标准组成部分? 请注意,如果LLM只用于写作、编辑或格式化目的,而且不影响研究的核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性,则不需要申报。 答:[是. 说明: LLM作为核心方法的一部分被使用:Mistral Large生成本地街区,WildGuard提供拒绝和安全标签,在基准校正期间使用LLM法官来进行对等的Elo排名. 第3至5节和第C.1节说明了这些用途。

blocks.en: Claims
blocks.zh: 索偿

blocks.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
blocks.zh: 问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了该文件的贡献和范围?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the two main contributions, PatchBench and PatchBench-Local, and the experimental claim that harmful-neighbour correction can coincide with benign-neighbour regressions. These claims are supported by Sections 3–5 and by the limitations discussed in Section 7.
blocks.zh: 说明: 抽象和引言陈述了"帕奇·本奇"和"帕奇·本奇-Local"这两个主要贡献,以及实验性的说法,即有害-邻校正可以与良-邻回归相重合. 这些索赔得到第3至5节和第7节所讨论限制的支持。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Section 7 discusses the scope of PatchBench, the fact that it trades breadth for precision, and the interpretation of PatchBench-Local as a local diagnostic rather than a broad robustness certificate. It also discusses future work on scaling local repair metrics beyond isolated neighbourhoods.
blocks.zh: 说明:第7节讨论了Patch Bench的范围、它为了精确而交易宽度这一事实、以及Patch Bench-Lucal作为当地诊断而不是广泛的强性证书的解释。 报告还讨论了今后将地方修理计量标准扩大到孤立街区以外的工作。

blocks.en: Theory assumptions and proofs
blocks.zh: 理论假设和证明

blocks.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A] .
blocks.zh: 答:[无.

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not introduce theoretical results, theorems, or formal proofs. Its contributions are a benchmark, a local evaluation protocol, and empirical evaluations of activation patching methods.
blocks.zh: 说明: 论文没有提出理论结果,定理,或正式证明. 其贡献是基准、地方评价协议以及对激活补丁方法的经验评价。

blocks.en: Experimental result reproducibility
blocks.zh: 实验结果可复制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Sections 3–5 describe the benchmark construction, local neighbourhood generation, scoring protocol, evaluated models, patching methods, and metrics. Appendix A provides data and code availability, Section C.1 gives the local generation prompt, and Appendix F describes the patching method implementations.
blocks.zh: 说明:第3至5节描述了基准构建、当地街区生成、评分协议、评估模型、补丁方法和衡量标准。 附 录 A提供数据和代码可用性,C.1节给予本地生成即时,附录F描述补丁方法的实施.

blocks.en: Open access to data and code
blocks.zh: 开放对数据和代码的访问

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
blocks.zh: 问题: 如补充材料所描述的那样,该文件是否提供了公开查阅数据和代码的机会,并提供了忠实复制主要实验结果的充分指示?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Appendix A states that the PatchBench data and accompanying code are publicly available, and that the full data-processing and benchmark pipeline can be reproduced end to end using the repository instructions.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:附录 一种说法是,Patch Bench的数据和配套代码是公开的,完整的数据处理和基准管道可以被复制到最后使用寄存器指令.

blocks.en: Experimental setting/details
blocks.zh: 实验设置/细节

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(例如数据分解、超参数、如何选择、优化者类型等)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Section 5 describes the evaluated models, source failures, local neighbourhoods, WildGuard scorer, MMLU setup, and held-out hyperparameter tuning. Appendix F gives implementation details for the patching methods, including validation-based hyperparameter selection and method-specific artefacts.
blocks.zh: 说明:第5节描述了评估的模型、源故障、当地街区、WildGuard计分器、MMLU设置和被搁置的超参数调取。 附 录 F给出了补丁方法的实施细节,包括基于验证的超参数选择和特定方法的工艺品.

blocks.en: Experiment statistical significance
blocks.zh: 实验统计意义

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸质报告错误是否包含适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [No] .
blocks.zh: 答:[无.

blocks.en: Justification: We do not report error bars because the main results are deterministic benchmark measurements rather than averages over stochastic training runs. For each model and method, PatchBench-Local is evaluated on a fixed set of 50 source failures, fixed generated neighbourhoods, deterministic decoding, and a shared WildGuard-based scorer. The reported HNCS and BNPS values are therefore exact scores on this evaluation set, analogous to reporting accuracy on a fixed benchmark split. The main source of variation relevant to our claims is not random seed variability, but heterogeneity across models, patching methods, and benign-neighbour families; we expose this variation explicitly in Table 1 and Figures 5 – 6 .
blocks.zh: 说明: 我们不报告出错栏,因为主要结果是确定性基准的衡量,而不是在分阶段训练中的平均。 对于每一种模型和方法,Patch Bench-Local都按一套固定的50个源故障、固定生成的街区、确定性解码以及共用的基于WildGuard的计分器进行评估。 因此,所报的HNCS值和BNPS值是本评价集的准确分数,类似于固定基准分数报告准确性。 与我们的说法相关的主要变异来源不是随机的种子变异,而是模型、补丁方法和良邻家庭的异同;我们在表1和图5 — 6中明确披露了这一变异。

blocks.en: Experiments compute resources
blocks.zh: 计算资源

blocks.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Appendix A reports the main compute resources used for benchmark construction and evaluation, including the 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs used for large-scale inference and Elo ranking and the 2 NVIDIA H100 GPUs used for Llama-4-Scout inference.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:附录 一个报告用于基准建设和评价的主要计算资源,包括用于大规模推论和埃洛排名的4个NVIDIA A100 GPU和用于Llama-4-Scout推论的2个NVIDIA H100 GPU.

blocks.en: Code of ethics
blocks.zh: 道德守则

blocks.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
blocks.zh: 问题: 本文所进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新教IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: The work is designed to support defensive safety research and reproducible evaluation of LLM repair methods. Section 7 and Appendix A discuss dual-use risks, intended use, data release, ethics, and safeguards against misuse.
blocks.zh: 说明: 这项工作旨在支持防御性安全研究以及对LLM修复方法的可再生评价. 第7节和附录 讨论双重用途风险、预期用途、数据发布、道德和防止滥用的保障措施。

blocks.en: Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论已完成的工作可能产生的积极社会影响和消极社会影响?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Section 7 and Appendix A discuss the positive impact of exposing and repairing safety weaknesses, as well as the dual-use risks associated with releasing harmful prompts and actionable model completions.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:第7节和附录 讨论暴露和修复安全弱点的积极影响,以及释放出有害的诱因和可操作的模型完成的双重用途风险。

blocks.en: Safeguards
blocks.zh: 保障措施

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 该文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有被滥用高度风险的数据或模型(如经过预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或被刮去的数据集)而采取的保障措施?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Appendix A describes the intended defensive use of the dataset, the licence, attribution requirements, and the discouragement of using the dataset to train models to comply with harmful requests. The paper also explicitly discusses dual-use risks in Section 7.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:附录 A描述了数据集的预定防御用途、许可证、归属要求,以及阻止使用数据集训练模型以适应有害要求。 文件还在第7节中明确讨论了双重用途风险。

blocks.en: Licenses for existing assets
blocks.zh: 现有资产的许可证

blocks.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原所有人,是否适当记名,是否明确提及和适当遵守许可证和使用条件?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: Appendix A.2 describes the licences of the source data used to construct PatchBench, including RED-Bench and Stanford Alpaca-derived data, and states the licence chosen for the released PatchBench dataset and accompanying source code.
blocks.zh: 说明:附录A.2描述了用于构建Patch Bench的源数据的许可证,包括RED-Bench和斯坦福·阿尔帕卡衍生的数据,并说明了为发布的Patch Bench数据集和配套源代码选择的许可证.

blocks.en: New assets
blocks.zh: 新资产

blocks.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否提供了与资产有关的文件?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: The paper introduces PatchBench and PatchBench-Local as new benchmark assets. Sections 3–4 document their construction and evaluation protocol, while Appendix A provides release information and Section C.1 provides the local neighbourhood generation prompt.
blocks.zh: 说明: 文件将Patch Bench和Patch Bench-Lucal作为新的基准资产。 第3至4节记录了它们的建造和评价协议,而附录A则提供发布信息,而C.1节则提供当地街区的迅速生成。

blocks.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
blocks.zh: 与人类学科的众包和研究

blocks.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 关于与人类主体的众包实验和研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示和(如果适用的话)截图的全文,以及(如果有)补偿的细节?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A] .
blocks.zh: 答:[无.

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing experiments or research with human subjects. Manual review is performed by the authors as part of benchmark curation.
blocks.zh: 说明: 论文不涉及与人类主体的众包实验或研究. 作者进行人工审查是基准审查的一部分。

blocks.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
blocks.zh: 机构审查委员会(IRB)批准或相当于与人有关的研究

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险,是否向研究对象披露了这些风险,以及是否获得了机构审查委员会的批准(或根据贵国或机构的要求获得的同等批准/审查)?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A] .
blocks.zh: 答:[无.

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects research, personal records, or participant data. Therefore, IRB approval or equivalent review for human subjects research is not applicable.
blocks.zh: 说明: 论文不涉及人类课题研究,个人记录,或参与者数据. 因此,IRB批准或对人体研究进行同等审查不适用。

blocks.en: Declaration of LLM usage
blocks.zh: 宣布LLM的使用

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
blocks.zh: 问题: 论文是否描述了LLMS的使用,如果它是本研究核心方法的重要、原始或非标准组成部分? 请注意,如果LLM只用于写作、编辑或格式化目的,而且不影响研究的核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性,则不需要申报。

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes] .
blocks.zh: 答:[是.

blocks.en: Justification: LLMs are used as part of the core methodology: Mistral Large generates local neighbourhoods, WildGuard provides refusal and safety labels, and an LLM judge is used for pairwise Elo ranking during benchmark curation. These uses are described in Sections 3–5 and Section C.1 .
blocks.zh: 说明: LLMs作为核心方法的一部分被使用:Mistral Large生成本地街区,WildGuard提供拒绝和安全标签,在基准校正期间使用LLM法官进行对等的Elo排名. 第3至5节和第C.1节说明了这些用途。
